Today went to play football scored a goal. Completed 2 nutmeg. Overall played good. Could not attend summerfest so i am annoyed. I got jealous of people who attended the fest. I thought i would enjoy my college life to the fullest and try new things but here i am doing the same thing and repeating the same mistakes. I just saw a junior of mine leaving nit rourkee after only 1 year, I think he is very successful and he is going to pursue his passion so he is dropping out of college(That is what i think). Seeing all this makes me jealous and annoyed with my life. I know that all this is not to be worried about and I should only focus on my present, social media is not a true reflection but i get distracted by it. Hopefully I will get better tomorrow, trying a little harder everyday.
Thank You.
